verdict.rationale: Zero's own AI features let users chat with their inbox, ask questions about mailbox and thread content, and compose emails with AI help, so natural-language interaction is a first-party capability. The evidence does not show that users can issue natural-language commands that carry out actions such as archiving, labeling or deleting inside the app. The MCP tools for those actions serve external agents and are not credited here as in-product natural-language operation. Missing for 10: documented in-app natural-language command execution for mailbox actions, depth and reliability of the chat assistant, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
